personas.name: completionist mapper
personas.goal: Visit every area, collect every coin, gem, relic, key and heart, open every locked door, and finish the level with the score and time bonus checked at the end.
personas.style: Walks with goto: macros to each item cluster, then sweeps remaining tiles with single steps. Checks the HUD after each pickup and the coin, key and door counts against the map. Finishes the level and confirms the Level complete dialog and the time bonus.

personas.name: sequence-breaker
personas.goal: Reach the exit, doors, gates and rewards in unintended orders: open a door before its key, step onto a closed gate, dash through walls, use levers in odd orders, and reach the exit with spare keys or near-zero timer.
personas.style: Tries illegal or early moves on purpose (dash into a locked door, dash with cooldown above 0, step onto spikes first, press use off a lever). After each attempt it verifies that the rule still holds and the state did not desync.

personas.name: chaos tester
personas.goal: Break transitions by pausing, restarting, quitting to menus, and pressing several keys in one tick while coins are being collected, while enemies are close, when a life is lost, and when the level is being finished.
personas.style: Spams multi-key tokens such as dash-right+pause, use+esc, left+right+up, and click:btn-resume during running ticks. Inserts pause and resume at boundaries (the tick a heart or spikes are hit, the tick the timer reaches 0, the tick the exit is stepped on). Checks that the frozen state stays frozen and that dialogs and buttons match the mode.

personas.name: literal newcomer
personas.goal: Follow the design document one sentence at a time and confirm each sentence against what the game does, including the map legend, the controls table, the dash recharge text and the list of items.
personas.style: Reads each rule as written: presses Shift plus arrow to dash, checks the HUD text for Dash 5 right after a dash, confirms that the Enter key activates the dialog's main button, and confirms that 5 coins are shown as Coins n/5. Reports any sentence the build contradicts.

personas.name: economy auditor
personas.goal: Drive score, lives, keys, coins, timer and dash counters to their limits and verify each amount, including the cap at 999,999, the floor at 0 for spikes, the 5-life cap for hearts, the 300 timer start, and the time bonus of 10 per tick left.
personas.style: Collects everything in different orders, takes spikes at low score, collects hearts at 5 lives, lets the timer run down to 0 and to 1, and checks the HUD number against the state number after every tick. Records every amount and compares it with the documented rule.

personas.name: photographer
personas.goal: Open every dialog and menu (pause menu, Level complete, Game over, victory) and check what each shows, its button labels, whether each visible button is on top and clickable, and whether anything covers a button.
personas.style: Opens the pause menu and checks Resume and Restart level, opens each end dialog and checks its text and Retry, Finish or Play again button, clicks every visible button once, and records the ui list (visible, text, rect, top) on each screen. Flags overlap, hidden buttons that still respond, and text that disagrees with the mode.

checks.rule: The player has between 0 and 5 lives (maximum 5).
Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999.
The timer runs from 300 down to 0 and never exceeds 300.
The level has 5 coins; the coin count never goes above 5.
The dash recharge is between 0 and 6.
The HUD score shows the current score.
The HUD lives field shows the current lives.
The HUD keys field shows the current keys.
The HUD coins field shows the current coin count as n/5.
The HUD time shows the ticks left on the timer.
The dash HUD shows 'Dash ready' when the recharge is 0 and 'Dash n' with n equal to the ticks until ready otherwise.
Score only goes down from spikes (500 points, floored at 0) or from a restart.
Collected coins, gems and relics never come back except on a restart.
checks.expect: cur.state.coins >= prev.state.coins && cur.state.gems >= prev.state.gems && cur.state.relics >= prev.state.relics

checks.rule: Keys go down only when a locked door is opened (one key per door).
The player makes at most one move per tick: a step (1 tile) or a dash (up to 2 tiles in a straight line).
checks.expect: abs(cur.state.player.x - prev.state.player.x) + abs(cur.state.player.y - prev.state.player.y) <= 2 && (cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x || cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y)

checks.rule: A dash sets the recharge to 6 and the HUD shows Dash 5 right after it (the tick ends with one countdown).
A tick in which the game becomes paused does not advance the timer or the clock.
While the game is paused nothing moves; timer, dash recharge, toasts and the clock are frozen.
checks.expect: cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && cur.state.dashCooldown == prev.state.dashCooldown && cur.state.clock == prev.state.clock && cur.state.toast == prev.state.toast && cur.state.player == prev.state.player && cur.state.enemies == prev.state.enemies

checks.rule: Every visible button must be clickable: nothing covers it.
Lives go down only from an enemy hit, spikes, or the timer reaching 0 (which resets the timer to 300).
At most one life is lost in a single tick.
After losing a life you reappear at the start (1,1).
Enemies cannot hurt you during the respawn tick or the next 4 ticks; spikes still hurt.
Touching an enemy costs one life and no points.
The player never stands on a wall, a closed gate or a locked door.
checks.expect: tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != '#' && tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != 'D' && (tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != '=' || cur.state.gateOpen == true)

checks.rule: Enemies move at most one tile per tick.
checks.expect: all(cur.state.enemies, e => abs(e.x - find(prev.state.enemies, p => p.id == e.id).x) + abs(e.y - find(prev.state.enemies, p => p.id == e.id).y) <= 1)

checks.rule: At 0 lives the game is over and the Game over dialog with Retry appears.
checks.expect: cur.state.mode == 'gameover' && any(cur.ui, u => u.kind == 'dialog' && u.visible && includes(u.text, 'Game over')) && any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-retry' && u.visible)

checks.rule: Stepping onto the exit shows the Level complete dialog with score, time bonus and a Finish button.
checks.expect: any(cur.ui, u => u.kind == 'dialog' && u.visible && includes(u.text, 'Level complete')) && any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-next' && u.visible)

checks.rule: Completing the level adds a time bonus of 10 points per tick left on the timer.
Restart level restores score 0, 3 lives, all items back, keys 0 and the timer at 300.
checks.expect: cur.state.score == 0 && cur.state.lives == 3 && cur.state.coins == 0 && cur.state.keys == 0 && cur.state.timeLeft == 300 && cur.state.mode == 'playing'

verdicts.title: Spikes corrupt score: 100 jumps to 65136, then goes negative (-300)
verdicts.observed: At tick 14 the player hits spikes at score 100 and the score becomes 65136 instead of 0 (100 - 500, floored at 0). Later a coin takes it to -300.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points with the score floored at 0. Score must stay within 0..999,999 and never go negative. From 100, a spike hit should give 0.

verdicts.title: Paused-frozen check misfires on Restart level
verdicts.observed: The timer jumps 299 to 300 while paused, but this comes from the Restart level action, which resets the timer by design.
verdicts.expected: Restart resets the timer to 300, so the frozen-timer rule does not apply to it. The real defect is the mode staying 'paused' after restart (see candidate 3).

verdicts.title: Enemy-speed check misfires on Restart level
verdicts.observed: Enemies jump back to their start tiles (e2 from (9,3) to (9,1)) because of the Restart level action, which is a legitimate reset.
verdicts.expected: Restart returns the level to its starting state, so enemy positions may reset. This is not a speed violation.

verdicts.title: Restart level leaves the game paused instead of running
verdicts.observed: After pause then click btn-restart, the state reads mode 'paused' and the pause menu's buttons remain. The score, lives and timer are reset, but the game is not running.
verdicts.expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away (mode 'playing', no pause menu).

verdicts.title: HUD coins shows 0/5 after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: After collecting a coin (state coins=1), the HUD reads 'Coins 0/5' while the score HUD already shows 100.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows current values, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: HUD time stale after resuming from pause
verdicts.observed: After clicking Resume, the state shows timeLeft 299 but the HUD still reads 'Time 300'.
verdicts.expected: The HUD shows the current timer value, so it should read 'Time 299' after the first running tick.

verdicts.title: Restart level leaves the game paused with no dialog, so input is ignored
verdicts.observed: After pause+right and click:btn-restart, the state stays mode=paused with no dialog or pause menu shown. Waiting for 25 more ticks changes nothing: timer stays 300, enemies do not move, and the player has no visible button to act on.
verdicts.expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away, so the timer and enemies should advance on the next tick.

verdicts.title: Toast covers the pause menu's Resume button
verdicts.observed: With the pause menu open, the 'Key collected' toast is on top of btn-resume, so btn-resume reports top=false and a click there would not reach it. btn-restart is not covered.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it, including toasts shown during the pause.

verdicts.title: Enemy position jump is the Retry restart reset, not a speed violation
verdicts.observed: The enemy moves from (2,5) to (6,5) on the tick of click:btn-retry. This is the level being reset after a game over, and the check does not exempt restarts.
verdicts.expected: Enemies move at most one tile per tick during play; a Retry restart legitimately resets enemy positions to their starting state, so this is not a bug.

verdicts.title: HUD coins stays at 0/5 after a dash collects a coin
verdicts.observed: After dash-down passes over a coin, state.coins is 1 and the score shows 100, but the HUD reads 'Coins 0/5' and stays stale while paused.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so after collecting one coin it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: HUD timer lags one tick behind the game timer
verdicts.observed: After click:btn-resume the state reads timeLeft=299 but the HUD still shows 'Time 300', and it remains 300 while paused on the next tick.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current timer value (ticks left), so it should read 'Time 299' to match the state.

verdicts.title: HUD coins not updated after a dash collects a coin
verdicts.observed: After dash-down at tick 12 collects a second coin, state.coins is 2 but the HUD shows 'Coins 1/5'. The HUD stays one behind.
verdicts.expected: The HUD shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 2/5' after the second coin is collected.
